text:
OpsBot: ALERT: PagerDuty PDR-4521 triggered — HighModelErrorRate on rw-infer-prod. multiple 5xx spikes detected across inference shards. Please ack.

Mia Chen: acked. I'm oncall, seeing spikes of 5xx across shards 3-7. traces show many 'model_asset_load_error' and some 'kv_cache_miss' errors. No obvious GPU OOM.

Arjun Patel: pulling logs now. lots of error_fingerprint=asset-miss-42, same stacktrace from runtime loader. hitting the same backend: s3-fetch timeout for a subset of models.

Sylvia Gomez: any customer-facing impact? dashboards?

Devon R: short-lived impact only. error rate peaked ~2.3% over last 5m, p99 latency stable. few SDK retries observed but no large throughput drop. looks like configuration mismatch during asset rollout.

Mia Chen: mitigation idea: reduce noise by increasing evaluation window and grouping alerts by fingerprint instead of per-shard. specifically: change alert window from 1m->3m and add dedupe/group key with error_fingerprint so we don't page for each shard burst. also propose a short Alertmanager silence for pure duplicates while we triage. :thumbsup:

Arjun Patel: prepared patch for alert rule. old rule:```
- alert: HighModelErrors
  expr: sum(rate(model_errors[1m])) by (shard) > 0.5
  for: 0m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
new rule:```
- alert: HighModelErrors
  expr: sum(rate(model_errors[3m])) by (error_fingerprint) > 0.5
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
    dedupe_key: '{{ $labels.error_fingerprint }}'
```
I'll push to alerting repo and reload Alertmanager.

Mia Chen: I've applied the change and created a 15m silence scoped to cluster=rw-infer-prod + severity=page so PD doesn't get a flood while we stabilize. command used:
```bash
curl -XPOST http://alertmanager.internal/api/v2/silences -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"cluster","value":"rw-infer-prod","isRegex":false}],"startsAt":"2026-03-14T09:05:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-14T09:20:00Z","createdBy":"mia","comment":"temporary burst suppression while we roll fix"}'
```
(note: pasted JSON for clarity in thread)

OpsBot: SYSTEM: Alert rule updated and silence applied (reload successful).

Sylvia Gomez: good. I've spun up an ephemeral dashboard to watch error_fingerprint counts + request ids: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/rw-infer-burst-watch (private). Sharing to incident doc. Also adding customer impact note: ~1.8% of requests returned transient 500s during the peak window; no large tenant-level outage observed.

Devon R: long-term: recommend adding a short-term clustering window (3-5m) and experiment with grouping key = error_fingerprint|model_name to avoid cross-model aggregation. Will open follow-up ticket and a canary rollout in staging.

Arjun Patel: opened INF-732 "experiment: clustering group key + 3m eval window" and linked CI job to run the rule in staging for 24h. CC @oncall for next 24h monitoring.

Mia Chen: handoff: I'll pass to next oncall @Olivia Hayes at 09:20Z. Summary: applied alert rule change (1m->3m), added dedupe key by fingerprint, temporary 15m silence, ephemeral dashboard created, INF-732 created for canary + follow-up. Keep an eye on sustained error rate >1% for >10m.

Oncall Rotation Bot: NOTE: Olivia Hayes is now oncall for 09:20Z-17:20Z.

Olivia Hayes: thanks, taking over. I'll watch the dashboard and let you know if we see sustained >5% or any tenant-specific spikes. reopening PD if it re-aggregates after silence expires.

Mia Chen: thanks team. action items: Arjun -> validate grouping behavior in staging (INF-732), Devon -> propose long-term routing changes to PD, Sylvia -> attach customer impact blurb to incident doc. will follow up with a short post-incident alert tuning RFC.

Arjun Patel: noted, will update INF-732 with test results.

OpsBot: INCIDENT: PDR-4521 status moved to MONITORING.
